evidence.quote: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now supports 50 enhanced fan-out consumers for On-demand Advantage streams.

evidence.heading: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now supports up to 50 enhanced fan-out consumers

evidence.quote: With On-demand Advantage mode, you can register up to 50 consumers per stream to use enhanced fan-out. With On-demand Standard and Provisioned streams, you can register up to 20 consumers per stream to use enhanced fan-out.
